author: John Hammond
description:
Shai-Hulud didn't just spread through compromised GitHub packages. The malware behind the campaign was later published as open source, making it available for anyone to examine or copy.

Does it matter if malware is "vibe coded" if it still gets the job done? It's an interesting question, especially when the code is now out in the open for anyone to study.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/Gk5mKCcM8dI?si=TbL-L7NGi7lD5RQx
title: Open Source Malware
